gnosh agents

  List the sessions that run in the background, and those that ran. The
  sessions gnosh --bg, /background and /fork started, from every folder (with
  --cwd, from that folder and the folders in it): the working ones first, then
  those done in the last week. Each is named by the start of its ID, which
  gnosh logs, gnosh stop and gnosh -r take.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh agents [flags]

Flags
  --json
      Print JSON instead of text: the working sessions, and with --all the
      others too. (Not built yet.)
  --all
      Also list every session that is done, not only those of the last week.
      (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
